description: AbstractSinglePredicate is an abstract Java class that provides a base implementation for predicates that hold a single value, specifically intended for MongoDB query predicates within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to retrieve the value, and overrides equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: AbstractSinglePredicate
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for predicates with a single value, providing common implementations for value handling, equality, hash code, and string representation.

methods.name: AbstractSinglePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a given value, which can be null.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the encapsulated value of the predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on class type and the encapsulated value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the encapsulated value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the predicate including its class name and value.
